blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Logistics costs come from a few big things. Fuel moves the trucks. Labour runs the warehouse. Storage holds the stock. These costs are big, and they are easy to see.

But there are small costs too. Empty trucks, wrong routes, and damaged pallets. We call these inefficiencies. They are silent. Nobody looks at them. But together they often cost more than the fuel.

Good cost management is not about cutting the big number. Everyone can see the big number. It is about finding the small numbers that nobody is looking at.

items.q: What are the big logistics costs in the text?
items.why: "Fuel moves the trucks. Labour runs the warehouse. Storage holds the stock."

items.q: What are examples of inefficiencies?
options: Empty trucks, wrong routes, and damaged pallets
items.why: "Empty trucks, wrong routes, and damaged pallets. We call these inefficiencies."

items.q: The text calls inefficiencies "silent". This suggests that…
options: they are hidden and people do not notice them
they make no noise in the warehouse
they are easy to see and everyone talks about them
items.why: Inferência: "silent" aqui quer dizer que ninguém repara neles — "Nobody looks at them."

items.q: Which idea would the author most likely DISAGREE with?
options: Small costs can add up to a lot of money.
The best way to save money is to cut the big number.
Nobody looks at the small costs.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que boa gestão NÃO é cortar o número grande — é achar os pequenos.

items.q: Why does the author focus on the small costs?
options: Because they are the biggest costs of all
Because they are easy to cut
Because together they can cost more than the fuel
Because everyone already looks at them
items.why: "together they often cost more than the fuel."

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie explicando o orçamento a um novo colega de finanças. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, welcome to the team. Let me show you this logistics budget. It is not so hard.

Look at the top line. Fuel. It is a big number, and everybody sees it. Every month someone asks me, "Can we cut the fuel?" But fuel is not our real problem.

Now look here, lower down. This is one truck. It goes out full, but it comes back empty. An empty return trip. That empty trip costs us money too. It makes the real cost of the journey twice as big.

Now add all the empty trucks together. Add the wrong routes. Add the damaged pallets. Look at this number at the bottom. It is bigger than the fuel line. Bigger. And nobody was looking at it.

So this is my question for you. Do not only watch the big number. Watch the small ones. That is where we save money. And this is not a one-time job. We check these numbers every month, not just once. My favourite number is cost per shipment. It is simple, and it tells you a lot. Let's look at it together now.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does Sophie say about the fuel line?
options: It is a number nobody can see
It is a big number, but it is not the real problem
It is not in the budget
It is the smallest cost in the budget
items.why: "Fuel. It is a big number… But fuel is not our real problem."

items.q: What happens with the one truck she shows?
options: It goes out full but comes back empty
items.why: "It goes out full, but it comes back empty. An empty return trip."

items.q: What is Sophie's main message to the new colleague?
options: Watch the small numbers too, because that is where you save money
items.why: "Do not only watch the big number. Watch the small ones. That is where we save money."

items.q: When Sophie says the empty trip makes the cost "twice as big", she means…
options: the fuel is cheaper on the way back
the truck goes twice as fast
you pay for the trip but only use half of it
items.why: Inferência: pagar a viagem inteira mas voltar vazio dobra o custo real de cada carga útil.

items.q: How does Sophie feel about the number at the bottom of the budget?
options: She is surprised and thinks it is important
She thinks it is too small to matter
items.why: Inferência: ela repete "Bigger" e diz que ninguém olhava para ele — quer chamar a atenção do colega.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The trucks need fuel to run." Fuel is…
options: the thing that powers the engine
items.why: Fuel = combustível, o que faz o motor funcionar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We pay the workers in the warehouse. That is our ___ cost."
items.why: Labour = mão de obra, o custo das pessoas que trabalham.

items.q: An empty truck on the way back is a problem because…
options: you pay for the trip but move nothing
items.why: Empty truck = caminhão vazio; você paga a viagem mas não transporta carga.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "All the small costs ___ to a big number at the end of the month."
items.why: To add up = somar-se; os pequenos custos se juntam num total grande.

items.q: "These costs are silent." Silent here means…
items.why: Silent = silencioso; aqui, custos que passam despercebidos.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões sobre custos. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "We need to cut costs this year." To cut costs means to…
items.why: Cut costs = cortar custos, gastar menos.

items.q: "Can the finance team sign off on this budget?" To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "Let's look into the empty trucks." To look into means to…
options: study them to understand the problem
items.why: Look into = investigar, examinar para entender.

items.q: "These small costs add up fast." To add up means…
options: to become a big total together
items.why: Add up = somar-se; juntos viram um número grande.

items.q: "A better route can save money." To save money means to…
options: keep money by not spending it
items.why: Save money = economizar, guardar dinheiro que não foi gasto.
